catalog.cleanupTaskRunsDescription: Delete task_run history older than the retention period to prevent unbounded table growth.
catalog.cleanupCacheEntriesDescription: Delete cache_entry rows older than the longest supported cache lifetime to prevent unbounded table growth.
catalog.matchNewTorrentsDescription: A low-frequency fallback scans torrents added after the index watermark, matches subscription gaps and recalculates new-release forecasts. Site sync normally triggers matching immediately; this task catches misses after restarts or sync failures.
catalog.downloadSourcesOrphanSweepDescription: Remove download source records whose library files were deleted and which remain unprocessed after 7 days.
catalog.ratioBoostDescription: Watch for new freeleech torrents on enabled sites and seed them promptly to improve the share ratio. Replace tasks with low upload efficiency within each site’s storage budget.
catalog.checkDownloadProgressDescription: Monitor downloaded-byte heartbeats: warn after 15 minutes without progress and search other sites for an equivalent-quality replacement after 30 minutes. Keep the old source until the replacement proves downloadable. Also verify completed download locations: warn when MovieClaw cannot see files, and reopen only missing episodes when content is incomplete. Watched import or library scanning handles ingestion; inventory reconciliation closes work orders.
catalog.syncSiteTorrentsDescription: On each global tick, inspect site cursors and fetch newly published torrents only for sites due for a sync, adding them to the local index.
catalog.refreshMediaMetadataDescription: Refresh complete TMDB records, including seasons, episodes, status, overview, ratings, cast, crew and images. New episodes create work orders for ongoing subscriptions and schedule changes are synchronized. Airing series refresh every 8 hours; ended titles and items without subscriptions refresh less often.
catalog.checkAppUpdateDescription: Check GitHub hourly for new application versions and NER models. Show the update entry in the sidebar when available; installation remains manual under Settings → Application. ETag conditional requests avoid GitHub API quota use when nothing changed. Applies only to Docker deployments.
catalog.driveReleaseSweepTitle: Free local space for cloud libraries
catalog.driveReleaseSweepDescription: For libraries whose primary root is on a cloud drive, delete local files only after upload verification, local derived processing and all reads finish. Keep sidecar files. Libraries configured to keep a local copy are excluded.
catalog.driveUploadSweepDescription: Queue local files not yet uploaded for libraries whose primary root is on a cloud drive, including new files and uploads that failed some time ago. New ingestion queues uploads immediately; this task is the fallback.
catalog.backfillNfoAbsorptionDescription: Read overview, rating, runtime, genres, cast and crew from local NFO files for items ingested before the upgrade. These fields previously came from reading NFO files on every detail-page visit; they now enter the database once at ingestion. Uses local disk only, without network requests or image downloads, and becomes a no-op when complete.
catalog.libraryIngestDescription: A low-frequency fallback restores invalid directory watches and checks source directories that cannot be watched. Watched directories are normally event-driven and are checked only while entries await file stability or downloader completion, or after 6 hours without a check when event delivery may have stopped, as can happen on network mounts.
catalog.driveChangesDescription: Fetch cloud drive activity such as uploads, transfers, moves and deletions. Process only changes within library cloud folders: mark deleted files as missing and relist only changed directories for other operations. Drives without an activity API use weekly reconciliation.
catalog.driveProbeSpecsDescription: Managed cloud files are ingested without reading their bytes. Gradually fill resolution, HDR and audio specifications using a small part of the daily budget, prioritizing new files. Files still missing specifications are probed when playback starts.
catalog.backfillMediaSeriesDescription: Add series membership, such as Harry Potter, to movies scraped before the upgrade. Series collections then appear automatically. Uses one lightweight detail request without rescraping metadata or downloading images, and becomes a no-op when complete.
catalog.libraryReconcileDescription: Reconcile library records with disk: add new files incrementally and mark disappeared files as missing. By default, records are retained. Libraries with automatic missing-record cleanup remove confirmed missing records. Covers cases missed by directory watching.
catalog.libraryRecyclePurgeDescription: Delete files past the recycle retention period and reconcile records whose pending-recycle files have already disappeared.
catalog.libraryRecycleOrphanSweepDescription: Use modification times to clean legacy files in recycle directories that have no inventory record.
catalog.searchWantedDescription: Take due work orders from the subscription gap queue and group them by media item for cross-site search. Used for backfill; ongoing subscriptions primarily use passive matching and enter this fallback queue only when due. Search results are added to the torrent index.
catalog.smartSelectionDueDescription: Recover smart submission intents and make decisions when a fixed deadline or observation window expires.
catalog.backfillUpgradeSnapshotsDescription: Fill quality snapshots for previously ingested units in subscriptions referenced by rule sets with upgrade targets. These snapshots are the baseline for upgrade comparisons. Runs gradually in database-only batches and becomes a no-op when complete.

directories.cacheImagesSummary: Local copies and thumbnails of remote images
directories.cacheImagesDescription: Local copies and thumbnails of posters, stills and site images, including resized Jellyfin variants. When the size limit is exceeded, the least recently accessed items are evicted automatically. Clearing this cache downloads images again when next requested.
directories.cachePlaybackSubsSummary: Subtitles and fonts extracted from video tracks
directories.cachePlaybackSubsDescription: Subtitles and fonts extracted from embedded video tracks are shared by the web player, subtitle previews and AI subtitle generation. Clearing this cache extracts them again on the next playback or preview. Large files require reading the entire container again, which can take a while.
directories.cacheAudioFingerprintsSummary: Audio fingerprints used to recognize episode intros and credits
directories.cacheAudioFingerprintsDescription: Intro detection creates a small audio fingerprint from the first 10 and last 7 minutes of each episode (about 33 KB per episode). Comparing fingerprints within a season identifies intros and credits. Clearing them preserves existing markers and Skip intro playback. However, adding new episodes requires reading older episodes again (about 6 seconds and several hundred MB per episode), so clear only when disk space is low. This cache also holds text recognized from a few end-credit frames; it is extracted again when recognition runs.
directories.cacheReelsClipsSummary: Small 1080p clips for previews and Reels
directories.cacheReelsClipsDescription: With Settings → Playback → Precut clips enabled, the server creates a small 1080p file for the chosen segment of each video. TV previews and Reels play it directly; each clip is roughly 10–30 MB. After clearing, previews show stills and Reels has no clips temporarily. When enabled, the server recreates clips while idle, which can take a long time for the whole library. Processing pauses while someone is watching.
directories.cacheOfflineExportsSummary: Full videos converted for 1080p, 720p or 480p app downloads
directories.cacheOfflineExportsDescription: When you download a video at a lower quality on iPhone, the server first converts it to an MP4 at that quality while the phone downloads it. Files are reclaimed after download completion or 72 hours without a request. Clearing this cache restarts conversion for downloads in progress.
directories.cacheReelsSummary: Chosen segment positions for each video
directories.cacheReelsDescription: Reels, the vertical clip feed at the top of a library, stores chosen segment boundaries and prefetch ranges in a small record per file. Clearing these records reads the file index again when that video next appears, usually in a fraction of a second. Clip cover images are stored with item images elsewhere.
directories.cachePlaybackCuesSummary: Video keyframe indexes that reduce data needed to start playback
directories.cachePlaybackCuesDescription: MKV files with many subtitle tracks can have a 1–2 MB index at the end, delaying startup over a slow connection. The server extracts video keyframes into a compact index of a few to tens of KB, sent to the phone with the playback session. There is one per file. Playback still works after clearing; the index is recreated in the background on the next play, usually in a fraction of a second.
directories.cacheSubtitleGenSummary: Image subtitle recognition results and translation checkpoints
directories.cacheSubtitleGenDescription: Image subtitle (PGS) recognition results and translation checkpoints created during AI subtitle generation. Extracted track files, including PGS images, are in Embedded subtitle cache and shared with the player. Files belonging to running subtitle jobs are skipped. Intermediates from completed jobs can be cleared safely.
directories.cacheTrickplaySummary: Thumbnails shown when seeking in the player
directories.cacheTrickplayDescription: Thumbnails displayed when seeking in the web player. Recreating them requires reading the entire video to extract frames. Prefer clearing only orphan directories for files no longer in a library.
directories.transcodesSummary: Cached web playback transcodes reused for resume and replay
directories.transcodesDescription: HLS segments produced by the web player. After a session ends, segments remain available for resuming or replaying the same video without transcoding again. Their size limit is one quarter of free disk space; unused segments expire after 24 hours. Clearing requires transcoding again on the next play. Active playback sessions are skipped.
directories.metadataCoversSummary: Library cover collages rendered by the server
directories.metadataCoversDescription: Library cover collages rendered by the server. They are rendered again automatically on the next request after clearing.
directories.metadataImagesSummary: Downloaded posters, backdrops and logos, plus local chapter images
directories.metadataImagesDescription: Downloaded posters, backdrops, title logos and stills are the source images for library display. Each item’s chapters/ directory holds locally extracted chapter images (8–12 images, about 1 MB per video). Generate chapters is disabled by default and applies only to libraries where enabled. Rebuilding everything requires refreshing metadata for the entire library, consuming substantial internet traffic and subject to TMDB rate limits, so only orphan cleanup is available.
directories.metadataPeopleSummary: Downloaded actor and director portraits, stored once per person
directories.metadataPeopleDescription: Portraits used by detail pages, person pages and Jellyfin. They are deduplicated by TMDB image path, stored once across all videos, and remain available offline. Portraits are separated by quality tier. After changing the tier, unused tiers can be cleared as orphans. Rebuilding everything requires downloading again, so clearing all is unavailable.
directories.databaseDescription: The SQLite database, including WAL logs, holds all settings, library records and viewing history.
directories.logsSummary: Daily backend logs with a 30-day rotation
directories.logsDescription: Daily backend logs are deleted after the retention period (LOG_RETENTION_DAYS, 30 days by default).
directories.uploadsSummary: Member avatars, home backgrounds and custom library covers
directories.uploadsDescription: Member avatars, home background images and custom library covers (library-covers/, removed with the library). These are user uploads and cannot be recreated.
directories.updatesSummary: Version code and database backups for in-app updates
directories.updatesDescription: Downloaded application versions, startup markers and automatic pre-update database backups. Set the number of retained versions under Versions and updates → Local versions to retain. Backups restore data during rollback and cannot be deleted here.
directories.modelsSummary: NER, voice detection and screen text recognition models
directories.modelsDescription: Torrent naming recognition (NER) and subtitle synchronization voice detection models are maintained by in-app updates. In local development, PP-OCR models used for intro and credits detection are also stored here; container images already include them.
directories.pluginsPatchSummary: Settings for disabling built-ins and enabling local plugins
directories.pluginsPatchDescription: Plugin overrides (plugins.yaml) can disable supported built-in subsystems and enable trusted local plugins with approved operations. Changes apply after restart. Deleting this file restores all defaults.
directories.pluginsLocalSummary: Plugin code written by the user
directories.pluginsLocalDescription: Trusted local Python plugins (docs/design/plugin-phase2a.md §6). Only plugins with local: true in plugins.yaml are loaded. packages/ holds installed third-party packages and installation records; data/ holds each plugin’s files (plugin-phase3.md §3, §6).
directories.pluginsBootSummary: Startup records used by plugin safe mode
directories.pluginsBootDescription: Records which local and third-party plugins loaded at the last startup and whether they ran reliably (plugin-phase3.md §5), used to decide whether to enter safe mode. Deleting these records forgets the previous startup without affecting data.
directories.pluginsFeaturesDescription: Records disabled features, who disabled them and when. Settings survive restarts (docs/design/plugin-page-tiers.md §6). Deleting this file re-enables all optional features.
directories.pluginsSafeModeSummary: A SAFE_MODE file starts the app in plugin safe mode
directories.pluginsSafeModeDescription: When this file exists, startup skips all local and third-party plugins. Exiting safe mode under Settings → Plugins deletes it.
directories.siteConfigsDescription: User-maintained site YAML files cannot be recreated.
directories.agentWorkspaceSummary: Working directory for agent file operations
directories.agentWorkspaceDescription: The working directory for agent file operations may contain files generated for you.
directories.agentSessionsDescription: Agent conversation transcripts and attachments are the source of conversation history. Deleting them loses the conversations.
directories.agentSkillsSummary: Custom skills added by an administrator
directories.agentSkillsDescription: Custom agent skills added by an administrator.
directories.configSummary: Settings stored outside the database, such as the public port
directories.configDescription: Settings files that must be read outside the database, such as the public port.
directories.secretKeyDescription: The master key protects sensitive settings such as site credentials. Deleting it makes all encrypted values permanently unrecoverable.
directories.demoReviewSessionsSummary: Public demo: credential digests issued to the review account
directories.demoReviewSessionsDescription: Only used on the public demo (MOVIECLAW_DEMO_MODE): SHA-256 digests of credentials issued to the review account. The guard uses these to authorize review operations (demo-site.md section 9). Deleting this file requires the reviewer to sign in again.
directories.demoSiteSummary: Public demo: torrent files and the demo resource catalog
directories.demoSiteDescription: Only used on the public demo: .torrent files and the catalog generated from the seed directory at startup (demo-site.md section 10). They are rebuilt at the next startup after deletion.
directories.demoDownloaderSummary: Public demo: task state for the demo downloader
directories.demoDownloaderDescription: Only used on the public demo: the demo downloader task list and progress (demo-site.md section 10). Deleting it clears all tasks in the demo downloader.
